question: For each VM state, among instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' while running on host 'blaze8-12', return the maximum (across display names in that VM state) of the per-display-name range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of network-info cache records per instance, along with the maximum instance count and maximum minimum-memory (in MB) observed for any display name in that VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH per_instance_cache_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    i.uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    COUNT(ic.id) AS cache_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb
),
per_display_name_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    display_name,
    vm_state,
    MAX(cache_count) - MIN(cache_count) AS cache_range,
    VARIANCE(cache_count) AS cache_variance,
    STDDEV(cache_count) AS cache_stddev,
    COUNT(*) AS instance_count,
    MIN(memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb
  FROM per_instance_cache_counts
  GROUP BY display_name, vm_state
)
SELECT 
  vm_state,
  MAX(cache_range) AS max_cache_range,
  MAX(cache_variance) AS max_cache_variance,
  MAX(cache_stddev) AS max_cache_stddev,
  MAX(instance_count) AS max_instance_count,
  MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb
FROM per_display_name_stats
GROUP BY vm_state

WITH per_instance_cache_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    i.uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    COUNT(ic.id) AS cache_count
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
    AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb
),
per_display_name_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    display_name,
    vm_state,
    MAX(cache_count) - MIN(cache_count) AS cache_range,
    VARIANCE(cache_count) AS cache_variance,
    STDDEV(cache_count) AS cache_stddev,
    COUNT(*) AS instance_count,
    MIN(memory_mb) AS min_memory_mb
  FROM per_instance_cache_counts
  GROUP BY display_name, vm_state
)
SELECT 
  vm_state,
  MAX(cache_range) AS max_cache_range,
  MAX(cache_variance) AS max_cache_variance,
  MAX(cache_stddev) AS max_cache_stddev,
  MAX(instance_count) AS max_instance_count,
  MAX(min_memory_mb) AS max_min_memory_mb
FROM per_display_name_stats
GROUP BY vm_state

SELECT d.vm_state,
       MAX(d.rng) AS max_range,
       MAX(d.variance) AS max_variance,
       MAX(d.stddev) AS max_stddev,
       MAX(d.cnt) AS max_instance_count,
       MAX(d.min_mem) AS max_min_memory_mb
FROM (
  SELECT i.vm_state,
         i.display_name,
         COUNT(i.cache_id) AS cnt,
         MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_mem,
         MAX(i.cache_id) - MIN(i.cache_id) AS rng,
         VARIANCE(i.cache_id) AS variance,
         STDDEV(i.cache_id) AS stddev
  FROM (
    SELECT i2.vm_state, i2.display_name, i2.memory_mb, c2.id AS cache_id
    FROM instances i2
    JOIN instance_system_metadata m
      ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid AND m.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    JOIN instance_info_caches c2
      ON c2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid
    WHERE i2.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
      AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12'
  ) i
  GROUP BY i.vm_state, i.display_name
) d
GROUP BY d.vm_state;
